narr: At the beginning of October, storms brought severe hail and flash flooding to portions of southern Utah.
ev: Capitol Reef National Park officials reported flows from Sheets Gulch into Sandy Creek.
Capitol Reef National Park officials relayed a public report of flows across Burr Trail Switchbacks, resulting in the road becoming impassable.
Capitol Reef National Park officials reported flash flooding on Sulphur Creek.
The Fort Pearce Wash gauge peaked at 789 cfs.
The Escalante at Escalante river gauge peaked at 518 cfs with a flood wave around 7 p.m.
